name: Neural LOD with 3D Gaussian Splatting
aliases: Neural LOD with 3D Gaussian Splatting on ANE
definition: A technique that replaces voxel-based Level of Detail (LOD) for distant terrain (LOD step ≥ 4) with 3D Gaussian Splatting rendered via a neural encoder on the Apple Neural Engine (ANE) to eliminate blocky distant terrain and reduce memory usage.
summary: Neural LOD with 3D Gaussian Splatting replaces distant voxel geometry with neural-generated splats on Apple hardware, eliminating blockiness and reducing memory by 70x.
